page.title: Ibihuza
page.intro: Huza amakonti yawe yo kwamamaza. Abarongozi bava mu kwamamaza kwawe bashika mu Barongozi banje ubwabo, n’amahera bakoresha n’igiciro ku barongozi.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form ijana mu Burongozi bwanje, amahera akoreshwa ku musi ku musi n’igiciro ku burongozi, n’uburyo bw’uburongozi burungikwa kuri LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

banner.connected: LinkedIn irahuye. Abarongozi bariko bararonswa ubu - iyi paji irahindurwa mu kanya nk'ako gukubita.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn ntirashirwaho kuri iyi server. Umuyobozi ategerezwa kwongerako ID y’umukiriya wa LinkedIn app n’ibanga.
banner.expired: Ihuriro LinkedIn ryaraheze, rero abarongozi ntibariko barakorana. Subira wihuze kugira ngo ukomeze.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn isaba ko wongera kwinjira muri {{date}} . Subira uhuze imbere y’aho kugira ngo amarongo agume atemba.

connect.title: Huza LinkedIn
connect.intro: Injira ukoresheje konti LinkedIn icungera amatangazo yawe. Leadrat isoma gusa amakonti yawe y’amatangazo, Lead Gen Form n’imibare y’amatangazo, kandi ikarungika amahinduka ufunguye.
connect.need1: Uruhara kuri konti y’itangazo LinkedIn (Umurorerezi canke hejuru).
connect.need2: Uruhara kuri paji y’ishirahamwe rihuye (Umuyobozi, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Umucungerezi canke Umusesanguzi) - LinkedIn isaba ko isangira abarongozi.
connect.need3: Ikibazo c'inomero ya telefone ku Lead Gen Forms - abarongozi batagira inomero ya telefone ntibashobora kwongerwako.

connection.title: Uguhuza
connection.autoRenews: Ukwinjira birasubirwamwo ubwavyo gushika ico gihe
connection.syncResult: Guhuza vyakozwe: {{received}} vyakiriwe, {{created}} vyaremwe, {{duplicates}} vyisubiriza, {{rejected}} vyanse.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Guca LinkedIn ? Gukoranya birahagarara kandi ibimenyetso vyo gushikamwo birafutwa. Abarongozi, imibare n’igitabo c’ibikorwa birabikwa.
connection.noPermission: Ushobora kuraba iyi paji. Guhuza no guhindura amategeko bikeneye uruhusha rwa "Gucungera amategeko".
connection.fetchHint: Ivyiyumviro bishasha birasuzumwa buri minota mikeyi kandi imisi 7 ya nyuma irasubirwamwo buri musi, rero ntaco ibura. Koresha ibi ku barongozi bavuye imbere y’uko uhuza, canke kugira ngo wongere usuzume igihe (gushika ku misi 90 ku gihe). Ivyiyumviro bimaze kuba muri Leadrat birasimburwa.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}} : {{received}} yabonetse, {{created}} yaremwe, {{duplicates}} vyisubiriza, {{rejected}} vyanse, {{skipped}} vyaramaze kwinjizwa.

accounts.title: Konti zo kwamamaza
accounts.intro: Abarongozi n'imibare birahuzwa bivuye ku ma konti y'amatangazo yafunguwe hano.
accounts.none: Nta konti y'amatangazo yabonetse kuri iyi konti LinkedIn . Suzuma uruhara rwa konti mu Campaign Manager LinkedIn , hanyuma usubiremwo.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Bwira LinkedIn uwo mu barongozi bayo yacitse ivyizigiro vy’ukuri. Iyo umurongozi LinkedIn ashitse ku rugero uhisemwo aha hepfo, Leadrat irabimenyesha LinkedIn , rero raporo zawe z’isekeza zigaragaza uburyo bw’umurongozi kandi LinkedIn ishobora kuronka abantu benshi bakunda umurongozi wawe mwiza. ID y’umurongozi wa LinkedIn gusa n’inzira imwe y’imeli nivyo birungikwa.
capi.created: Ihinduka ryakozwe kuri LinkedIn kandi ryashizwe ku ikarita.

activity.title: Igitabo c'ibikorwa
activity.intro: Ivyo vyose biri hagati ya Leadrat na LinkedIn : amahuza, uguhuza kwose, uburongozi bwose n’ivyashikiye, uguhinduka n’amakosa.
